summary: Completed backend + frontend RBAC testing for DevStart Admin panel (Phase 1). 16/16 backend pytest cases passed and all critical frontend admin flows verified (admin login sees nav-admin, regular user cannot see nav-admin and gets redirected from /admin to /dashboard, admin can access Stats/Users/Templates tabs, owner delete button disabled, template create+delete works end-to-end).

design_issues.screen: Admin Templates dialog / Delete confirm dialogs
issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby on DialogContent (2 instances). Non-blocking but should be fixed with DialogDescription.

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix Dialog/AlertDialog contents in Admin.jsx to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: JWT has no server-side revocation and no refresh — acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
server.py: /api/templates is behind auth (Depends(current_user)) — Explore page will only work for logged-in users. Confirm this matches product intent.
server.py seed_on_startup uses deprecated FastAPI on_event; consider lifespan handler.
Admin.jsx (~339 lines) is fine size-wise but combines three tabs — extraction into files would improve maintainability if it grows.
RBAC guards look solid: role always re-read from DB in current_user, owner cannot be demoted or deleted, last-admin protection present, no self-escalation endpoint.
test_credentials: Owner admin: yagoadd@gmail.com / admdevstart1 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Regular users registered on the fly via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_ / test_ui_ created and cleaned up after role-change test. UI test created a temporary TEST_UI_TPL_* template and deleted it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_rbac.py covers auth roles, admin-only access, security (401/403), owner/last-admin guards, and role-change persistence. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_rbac.py -v. Frontend testids on Admin: admin-panel, tab-stats/users/templates, admin-user-row-{id}, role-select-{id}, delete-user-{id}, confirm-delete-user-{id}, new-template-btn, tpl-name/desc/level/language/framework/goal, save-template-btn, admin-template-{id}, edit-template-{id}, delete-template-{id}, confirm-delete-template-{id}. Navbar admin link: nav-admin.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only non-critical a11y console warning about missing DialogDescription on Radix DialogContent inside Admin.jsx — fix by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to Dialog and AlertDialog contents.
